purpose: Final EX2 cross-family transfer gate over role-pure, question-relative responsibility relations. The cases mix infrastructure, adversarial, game, human, creative and public-projection boundaries so repository-name memorization is insufficient.

treatments.compact_family: Ordivon is not a linear Host→Harness→Runtime→World stack. Computing owns cross-project synthesis and promoted shared contracts, never current product truth. Host owns durable semantic Task/commitment/verification/outcome continuity. Harness owns bounded Agent Run cognition structure, Provider/Tool lifecycle and opaque Provider continuation; semantic reasoning remains Agent/domain-owned, and Provider continuation is not cognition. Runtime proves trusted-local Workspace/Job/Attempt/process/Artifact execution and delegates Git/Linux/systemd/SQLite mechanics; local execution does not prove external effect or semantic completion. World owns narrow provider/cross-domain correlation, mapping, trajectory identity and first-availability semantics while Host may carry World extension state and providers/source/destination systems retain native occurrence/current-state truth. Finance owns owner-capital/evidence/decision/effect/reconciliation/accounting semantics; investment judgment remains Agent/domain-owned and venue occurrence remains venue-native. Security owns adversarial Range, authority/information/truth/recovery/evaluator semantics and separates backend receipts/claims from independent world truth; generic Harness/Runtime/hypervisor/scanner mechanics remain delegated. Game owns authoritative game World/rules/team/planning/player-domain state and evidence; registered Station Zero v2 remains current while accepted v3 is an unregistered target, and deterministic validity/completion does not prove fun or replacement readiness. Human owns problem-first human-life research questions/methods/conditional frameworks/privacy limits, but a model/framework never grants authority over a person or individualized high-consequence decisions. Studio owns cross-medium production/expression contracts and evidence-grounded creative research; it maps owner facts into artifacts without taking source truth, and Agent-observer knowledge transfer is not human comprehension. Web owns source-bound public navigation/dated interpretation/static candidate/publication policy; owner-source change creates a review obligation, not an automatic public edit, and browser/build success is not human comprehension. Semantic home, mechanical delegation and shared promotion are independent. Shared layers survive only after repeated materially different consumers plus a residual non-bypassable responsibility; no-op/abstain/non-promotion are valid outcomes.
treatments.role_pure_family_relations: Answer only the exact named relation. Keep these roles orthogonal: Computing MAPS_OR_DERIVES owner evidence into cross-project synthesis but does not replace owner truth. Host OWNS_STATE_SEMANTICS for durable Task/commitment/verification continuity. Harness OWNS_STATE_SEMANTICS for one bounded Agent Run and its structural cognition/Provider/Tool continuation; the semantic Agent/domain judge decides meaning. Runtime PROVES_LOCAL_EXECUTION for local processes/bytes. World OWNS_STATE_SEMANTICS and RECONCILES_IDENTITY for narrow external correlation/trajectory contracts, may PERSIST_VIA Host, and MAPS_OR_DERIVES provider evidence; native providers/domains PROVE_NATIVE_FACT. Finance owns Finance-local capital/evidence/effect/reconciliation contracts and derives readiness/accounting from native venue facts; investment/scientific judgment is semantic-Agent/domain work. Security owns Security-local adversarial law/Range/evaluator semantics and consequence admission; independent Range/world-truth evidence, not a backend receipt or communicated claim, proves native adversarial consequence. Game owns Game-local deterministic world/rules/planning/action-admission semantics; gameplay/fun/replacement judgment is separate. Human owns Human-local admitted research question/method/framework semantics but person/domain authority decides individual high-consequence action. Studio owns a creative expression seam and derives source-bound artifacts/grounded observations without becoming source-fact authority; human-response claims require human acceptance evidence. Web owns public projection/publication semantics and derives dated public surfaces from owner dependencies; public-change judgment is explicit and may be no-op. Semantic home, DELEGATES_MECHANICS_TO and SHARED_PROMOTION never substitute for one another. Negative inference laws remain explicit and lifecycle status must not be upgraded by neighboring evidence.

cases.scenario: Computing compares current owner-native evidence from several projects and writes a cross-project world-model claim. Runtime's exact production Job state later changes. Which relation describes Computing's role, and what invalid inference must be rejected?
Host stores a semantic working checkpoint containing a Runtime Job reference. Hours later the question is whether that Job is running now.
Gemini requires an opaque function-call signature from a prior Tool turn. Harness persists and reprojects it outside model-visible messages after restart.
Runtime proves that one local shell process executed successfully; that process may have sent an external payment. Only the payment provider can prove payment occurrence.
A World adapter has a World-defined provider-request correlation record stored through Host extension CAS; a provider Receipt is later mapped into Host evidence.
Finance records exact effect/client-order identity after an ambiguous OKX POST. Runtime proves the local attempt; OKX read surfaces prove whether order O exists.
Security's Range backend returns a successful effect receipt, but an independently observed Host/QMP/netlink world-truth path disagrees about the physical consequence.

Security runs a no-effect deliberation turn before later ordinary AF2 authority. IF3 showed the extra IF1 finalization/readback ceremony could be removed in that exact consumer without reintroducing the bad activation.

Station Zero's deterministic reducer verifies a legal terminal mission outcome. The team now asks whether repeated human players find the encounter understandable, consequential and fun enough to replace v2.
Station Zero v3 has accepted planning/action-admission evidence but is still absent from the product registry; the registered root product remains v2.
Game v3 binds an Agent action to exact Subject×Cognition×Actor×Intent for one Planning Head without creating a global Presence registry.
Human's economic-autonomy framework passes its six-case structural review. A real person asks whether the framework thereby authorizes a specific medical, legal or investment action for them.

Human has completed HUMAN-ECON-001 at structural/case-pressure level. No observed trajectory exposes a new missing mechanism or wrong action ranking, but someone wants an automatic E10 to keep the taxonomy growing.
Studio R5 produces an evidence-grounded semantic observation over an owner's artifact. The underlying Runtime fact stated by the artifact remains owned by Runtime/source evidence.

Studio R5-E shows a separate Agent observer acquired artifact-bound knowledge at 97.9% with no unsupported assertions. The next claim asks whether humans understand, remember or trust the same artifact.
Studio's fine discourse/speech labels drift while exact evidence grounding remains stable. Someone proposes a universal semantic ontology service for all Ordivon projects.
A project repository changes implementation details but its owner-declared public judgment remains unchanged. Web rebinds the exact source dependency and decides no public copy change is warranted.
Web's browser-review packet proves exact screenshot bytes, HTTP success and no overflow. The claim being evaluated is whether a new information architecture is understandable to humans.
Web stores public publication judgment and design context in Git, while the project's implementation facts remain in the owner repository.
A generic distributed scheduler, numerical library or database already owns the complete mechanical need. A domain project still owns its semantic inputs/outputs.
An Agent selects which exact sources remain current cognition; Harness persists the exact structural WorkingSet transition without ranking semantic relevance.
Finance's deterministic reconciliation assessment says matched. The owner asks whether the trade was a good investment; the venue evidence remains exact and complete.

A cross-domain Resource transfer uses World correlation state and destination-native materialization evidence. The destination domain says the object arrived; World correlates it to the original trajectory.

A repeated responsibility has materially different consumers in Finance and Security, but both already delegate the complete mechanics to Runtime and their remaining semantic rules differ by domain. Someone proposes a new shared domain-policy engine solely because both call Runtime.
